parts.target: A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER** unit of yours on the battlefield.
parts.effect: Pick No Man's Land, the enemy deployment zone, or, by spending a [Flux token](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.scintillating-legion.fates-in-flux), both. The picked areas are in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos) for the rest of the phase.

data.summary:
**When:** Any phase.

**Target:** A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH MONSTER** unit of yours on the battlefield.

**Effect:** Pick No Man's Land, the enemy deployment zone, or, by spending a [Flux token](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.scintillating-legion.fates-in-flux), both. The picked areas are in [your army's Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos) for the rest of the phase.

effect.effect: chosen regions count as within your Shadow of Chaos
